explanation.headline: Olanzapine is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; a registered plant for a labeled product has OAI inspections and recent Class II and Class III recalls for olanzapine tablets

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include olanzapine as of 2026-10-21.
A product label for olanzapine 10 mg (NDC 33342008411) names Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited as the labeler and a registered plant (FEI 3007517881) in India.
That plant received OAI classifications after inspections ending 2017-11-24 and 2021-11-01.

The same plant was subject to a Class II recall of olanzapine 10 mg tablets initiated 2022-02-16 (D-0639-2022), a Class II recall of olanzapine 2.5 mg tablets initiated 2024-11-25 (D-0154-2025), and a Class III recall of olanzapine 5 mg tablets initiated 2026-08-27 (D-0867-2026), all for cGMP deviations or failed impurity specifications.
The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Alkermes, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

rejected.text: Current inventory across three sites ranges from 11.7 to 28.8 days on hand for the 10 mg tablet presentation.
rejected.reason: "three" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence
